Loose tires lie in the foreground of all three photos.
Yellow chalk markings are visible on several tire sidewalls.
Watermark 'IKWE ANTHONY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appear on photos 1 and 2.
No tire brand, model, or country-of-origin marking is legible in any photo.

Close-up of any 'Made in Belgium' sidewall marking
